title: H. G. Wells: The War of the Worlds — Ep 03/27 — "On Horsell Common"
description:
The War of the Worlds, Episode 3. By nine in the morning twenty people stand round the pit on Horsell Common, staring at the Thing that fell in the night. Boys throw stones at it. The crowd came for charred corpses and found something like a rusty gas float. Only the narrator climbs down close enough to see that its metal is like nothing on earth.

By afternoon the evening papers have startled London, the road is crowded with cabs and carriages, and Stent, the Astronomer Royal, stands on the cylinder shouting orders to the diggers. Ogilvy calls the narrator down into the pit and asks a favour: the lid will not unscrew, the crowd is in the way, and now and then something inside still stirs.

Chapter III of Book One of H. G. Wells's The War of the Worlds (1898), in the public domain.

— The Keeper's Lantern —
Every episode is one whole chapter, in order, from the first page to the last.
